answer: Use stake-backed task clusters with random peer checks. 1) A worker locks 68 POA for 30 days and commits a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden tasks; three established peers from separate funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, matching outputs, or synchronized claims collapse linked keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 68,000 POA, risks 34,000, and requires 4,000 tasks plus 12,000 reviews. Like a quill crossing shale beneath a ridge, each verified worker leaves one trace; aliases cannot make the path wider.
